mesmer.definition: n. Austrian physician who tried to treat diseases with a form of hypnotism (1734-1815)

mesmeric.definition: s attracting and holding interest as if by a spell
mesmeric.translation:
a. 催眠术的
[医] 催眠术的

mesmerise.definition:
v attract strongly, as if with a magnet
v induce hypnosis in
mesmerise.translation: vt. 对...施催眠术, 使目瞪口呆, 使入迷

mesmerised.definition:
v attract strongly, as if with a magnet
v induce hypnosis in
s having your attention fixated as though by a spell
mesmerised.translation: vt. 施以催眠术；使…入迷；使…目瞪口呆 (mesmerise的变形)

mesmerising.definition:
v attract strongly, as if with a magnet
v induce hypnosis in
mesmerising.translation: vt. 施以催眠术；使…入迷；使…目瞪口呆

mesmerism.definition: n the act of inducing hypnosis
mesmerism.translation:
n. 催眠术, 催眠状态
[医] 催眠术

mesmerist.definition: n a person who induces hypnosis

mesmerization.definition:
n. The act of mesmerizing; the state of being
   mesmerized.
mesmerization.translation: n. 施催眠术, 催眠状态

mesmerize.definition:
v attract strongly, as if with a magnet
v induce hypnosis in
mesmerize.translation:
vt. 施催眠术, 迷住, 迷惑
[医] 催眠

v attract strongly, as if with a magnet
v induce hypnosis in

mesmerized.translation: v. 使入迷( mesmerize的过去式和过去分词 )
